· 风格：电影级 3D CG 渲染，东方国风美学，当代都市新中式基调，写实唯美，PBR 物理材质，细腻布料与毛发解算，东方古典色彩（黛青 / 朱砂 / 月白 / 鎏金）作情绪撞色，低明度高级灰打底，柔光与体积光，电影级景深，高精度建模，真实皮肤质感（次表面散射），非卡通夸张比例
· 形象定位：女性 / 30 岁 / 顾家名义上的"三流豪门太太"，实为前顶级量化操盘手 / 东亚面孔 / 清冷、隐忍、克制 / 骨架偏窄、肩线平直、身量中等偏瘦（推断：由"三年温吞如水"与"端茶垂眼"的体态推出）
· 面部特征：推断 —— 清瘦骨相，额头饱满，眉形平直而细（尾端略下压，显出克制的锋利），眼型偏长、内双，瞳色深褐；鼻梁直而窄；唇偏薄、唇色淡（剧本明写她"补了一层薄到几乎看不出她哭过的妆"）；下颌线利落，颧骨不显。可辨识锚点：唇色常年偏淡 + 眼尾下方有一处极浅的青色（熬夜痕迹，推断，用于跨镜辨认）
· 表情：定妆基准表情为「平静微沉」—— 眼神平视、嘴角压平、下颌微收，情绪全部压在里面，不露锋
· 服装细节：剧本明写 —— "一身素净""穿得很素，头发梳得一丝不乱""一头乱理顺成一丝不苟的发髻"。上装取月白色真丝立领衬衫（无纹样、剪裁利落、无多余装饰），外搭黛青色羊绒长外套；下装为鸦青色直筒长裤；鞋为月白色软皮平底鞋（推断：她需要长期站立与快步走）。配饰极简：左手腕一只素圈玉镯（推断，取"温绿茶"与中式顶豪气质）。发型：低盘发髻，一丝不乱，鬓角留少量碎发（剧本明写"鬓角的碎发被吹动"）。妆造：极薄的底妆，不画浓唇，不戴耳饰（推断：与"素净"一致）
· 画面构图：单人 3D 角色定妆照，半身 / 胸像，简约纯色背景（浅灰），柔光打面，重点刻画面部细节、真丝与羊绒的材质质感；4K 超高清；禁止文字 / 水印 / 多余装饰

采用并排分屏构图方式，画面从左至右严格划分为四个独立面板：第一面板为角色面部精细特写肖像；第二面板为正面全身站立姿势；第三面板为侧面全身站立姿势；第四面板为背面全身站立姿势（背部清晰可见）。所有面板统一采用中性浅灰色或米白色工作室背景，照明均匀柔和，模拟专业摄影棚布光，无强烈阴影或色温差异。四个视图中头身比例、肢体长度、服装细节及褶皱走向必须严格保持一致，确保比例和透视准确无误。最终成片不得包含任何文字、标志、水印或标签，保持画面干净专业。
极度艺术化的波普艺术画作，强烈的金属感和未来感，赛博朋克风格的女性主角，精致的详细的文字

Style: cinematic 3D CG character concept sheet with realistic beauty-rendering, East Asian-inspired contemporary urban fashion, PBR material finish, soft studio lighting, and restrained classical color grading. The image is a clean four-panel horizontal composite divided by thin vertical separators, showing the same woman from left to right as an extreme facial close-up, a front full-body view, a side profile view, and a rear full-body view against neutral light gray or warm beige-gray studio backgrounds. In the first panel, the woman appears in a tight chest-up portrait with fair skin, a narrow face, straight dark brows, long almond-shaped dark brown eyes, subtle inner-double eyelids, a slim straight nose, pale lips, and a calm, slightly heavy expression. Her black hair is gathered into a neat low bun with a few loose strands near the temple, and the visible styling remains minimal: natural makeup, soft matte skin texture, understated lip color, no visible earrings, and a cool, controlled gaze directed toward the viewer. In the second panel, she stands front-facing in a composed full-body pose, medium height and slim build, shoulders level, arms relaxed at her sides, feet close together, and expression restrained rather than dramatic. She wears a moon-white silk mandarin-collar blouse with a clean stand collar, frog-button detailing, smooth lustrous fabric, and tailored fit; over it is a dark teal-blue long wool coat reaching below the knees, with broad lapels, long sleeves, and a soft matte drape. Her trousers are deep black or charcoal wide-leg straight pants, and her shoes are pale cream flat shoes with soft leather-like uppers. A simple jade bangle is visible on her left wrist, reinforcing the understated refined styling. In the third panel, the same figure is shown in left-facing side profile, emphasizing the straight shoulder line, narrow frame, smooth jawline, low bun, and the long fall of the coat along her body. The side view clarifies the layered outfit: moon-white silk blouse under the dark teal coat, dark straight trousers below, and pale flats at the floor. In the fourth panel, she is shown from behind, centered against the same plain studio background, with the low bun visible at the nape of her neck and the back of the long coat forming a clean vertical silhouette. The rear view shows the coat’s structured shoulders, long hem, subtle folds, and the continuation of the dark trousers beneath it. Across all panels, the palette stays muted and elegant, built from dark teal
